nodes.name: permission_log.js
nodes.summary: Client-side form controller for Permission Log DocType. Renders a table showing changed permission values (from/to) including support for child table changes with nested tables.

nodes.name: permission_log.py
nodes.summary: Python controller and utility functions for Permission Log DocType. Provides make_perm_log() hook to capture permission changes, insert_perm_log() for creating log entries, and get_changes()/get_changes_diff() for computing field-level diffs between document states.

nodes.name: permission_log_list.js
nodes.summary: List view settings for Permission Log. Hides the name column and disables comment count display.

nodes.name: test_permission_log.py
nodes.summary: Empty test stub for Permission Log DocType extending IntegrationTestCase.

nodes.name: permission_type.js
nodes.summary: Commented-out placeholder client-side controller for Permission Type DocType.

nodes.name: permission_type.py
nodes.summary: Python controller for Permission Type DocType. Manages custom permission types per DocType by creating custom Check fields on Custom DocPerm, DocPerm, and DocShare. Handles developer-mode restrictions, file export/delete, and provides get_doctype_ptype_map() cached lookup.

nodes.name: test_permission_type.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for Permission Type DocType. Tests custom permission type creation on a DocType (approve on Web Page), verifies custom fields are created, permission granting/revoking works, and reserved name validation.

nodes.name: prepared_report.js
nodes.summary: Client-side form controller for Prepared Report DocType. Renders filter values table, provides 'Show Report' button for completed reports, 'Download as CSV' for conversion, and 'Cancel Prepared Report' for queued/started reports.

nodes.name: PermissionLog
nodes.summary: Document controller for Permission Log. Minimal controller with a computed property 'changed_at' that returns the document creation timestamp.

nodes.name: make_perm_log
nodes.summary: Hook function called on document events. Checks if the document supports permission logging via get_permission_log_options(), skips logging during permission resets for Custom DocPerm deletions, then delegates to insert_perm_log().

nodes.name: insert_perm_log
nodes.summary: Creates a Permission Log document recording permission changes. Supports custom_changes for reset-to-standard operations or computes diff via get_changes(). Handles status determination (Updated/Added/Removed) and ensures role/parent fields are included for Custom DocPerm entries.

nodes.name: get_changes
nodes.summary: Computes the diff between current and previous document states. Returns tuple of (current_changes, previous_changes) after filtering fields and comparing values.

nodes.name: get_changes_diff
nodes.summary: Computes field-level differences between current and previous document values. Uses set operations for child table comparison (symmetric_difference) and direct comparison for scalar fields.

nodes.name: get_filtered_changes
nodes.summary: Filters document changes to only include specified fields. Supports filtering child table documents to specific sub-fields via dict entries in the filter list.

nodes.name: PermissionType
nodes.summary: Document controller for Permission Type. Manages custom permission types per DocType. On insert/update creates custom Check fields on DocPerm, Custom DocPerm, and DocShare targets. Validates against reserved standard rights. Restricts creation/deletion to developer mode. Handles file export for app development.

nodes.name: get_doctype_ptype_map
nodes.summary: Site-cached function that returns a mapping of DocType names to their custom permission type lists. Queries all Permission Type records and groups them by doc_type.

nodes.name: IntegrationTestPermissionType
nodes.summary: Integration test class for PermissionType. Tests the full lifecycle: creating a custom 'approve' permission type on Web Page, verifying custom fields are created on DocPerm/Custom DocPerm/DocShare, granting/revoking the permission, and rejection of reserved permission names.
